record_scope_reconstruction: Regular Tchissanda–Kamako road crossing and associated border markets in Lunda Norte–Kasai. Symbolic Kamako reopening does not prove simultaneous ordinary traffic at every Angola–DRC crossing.

source_checks.finding: March 30 governor account names Tchissanda and border markets; refugee arrangements remain separate.
March 31 ceremony at Kamako called symbolic by governor; it authorizes markets, not direct observation of all ordinary passage.

phase_decisions.phase_applicability: Tchissanda–Kamako regular road/market policy only, March 2017 bounded onset to March 31 2018.
